InventoryCreate.description:
The stock to store for a product.

Quantities cannot be negative and have at most two decimals.
InventoryCreate.title: InventoryCreate

InventoryOut.description: A stock row as the API returns it.
InventoryOut.title: InventoryOut

InventoryPatch.description:
A partial edit of a stock row.

Quantity, threshold and unit can be changed but never cleared. `reason` is not a
column: it says why the quantity changed and goes to the diary of stock changes.
InventoryPatch.title: InventoryPatch

InventoryWithProductOut.description: A stock row together with its product and whether it is low on stock.
InventoryWithProductOut.title: InventoryWithProductOut

MovementOut.description: One change of the stock of a product, as the diary returns it.
MovementOut.title: MovementOut

ProductCreate.description: The fields needed to create a product by hand.
ProductCreate.title: ProductCreate

ProductOut.description: A catalogue product as the API returns it.
ProductOut.title: ProductOut

ProductPatch.description: A partial edit of a product. Only the fields that are sent change.
ProductPatch.title: ProductPatch

PurchaseSummaryOut.description: What registering the picked-up lines did.
PurchaseSummaryOut.title: PurchaseSummaryOut

ReviewCandidateOut.description: A product the weekly review asks about.
ReviewCandidateOut.title: ReviewCandidateOut

ScanRequest.description: A code read by a scanner, and what to do with it.
ScanRequest.title: ScanRequest

ScanResultOut.description: What happened when a code was scanned. Every outcome is a normal 200 answer.
ScanResultOut.title: ScanResultOut

ShoppingListItemCreate.description: A product to put on the shopping list. Adding one already there sums it.
ShoppingListItemCreate.title: ShoppingListItemCreate

ShoppingListItemOut.description: One line of the shopping list.
ShoppingListItemOut.title: ShoppingListItemOut

ShoppingListItemPatch.description: A partial edit of a line of the shopping list. Neither field can be cleared.
ShoppingListItemPatch.title: ShoppingListItemPatch

get.description: Reports that the service is up.

Lists the tracked items with their product.

Args:
    low: When true, only the items that need restocking are returned.
    service: The inventory service.

Returns:
    Each item with its product and a flag that says whether it is low on stock.

schema.title: Response List Inventory Api Inventory Get

post.description:
Starts tracking a product that is in the catalogue.

Args:
    payload: The stock to store.
    service: The inventory service.
    source: Where the request comes from, from the `X-HomeStock-Source` header.

Returns:
    The stored item.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not in the catalogue, 409 when it is
        already tracked, 422 when a freezer-only field is sent outside the freezer.

delete.description:
Stops tracking a product. Its catalogue entry and its history are kept.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    service: The inventory service.
    source: Where the request comes from, from the `X-HomeStock-Source` header.

Returns:
    An empty 204 response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not tracked.

patch.description:
Edits the stock of a tracked product. Only the fields that are sent change.

`reason` is not a column: it says why the quantity changed and goes to the diary.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    payload: The fields to change.
    service: The inventory service.
    source: Where the request comes from, from the `X-HomeStock-Source` header.

Returns:
    The updated item.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not tracked, 422 when a freezer-only
        field would stay set outside the freezer.

get.description:
Lists the diary of stock changes, the most recent first.

Args:
    ean: Keep only this product's movements.
    reason: Keep only movements with this reason.
    limit: Most rows to return.
    offset: Rows to skip.
    service: The movement service.

Returns:
    The movements, each saying whether it was undone.

schema.title: Response List Movements Api Movements Get

get.description:
Returns the most recent movement.

Args:
    service: The movement service.

Returns:
    The latest movement, or `null` when the diary is empty.

schema.title: Response Last Movement Api Movements Last Get

post.description:
Reverts a movement by writing a compensating one. Nothing is deleted.

Args:
    movement_id: The movement to revert.
    service: The movement service.

Returns:
    The compensating movement.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the movement does not exist; 409 when it was already
        undone, its product is no longer tracked, or the stock would not change.

get.description:
Searches the catalogue by name or brand.

Args:
    q: The text to look for.
    repo: The product repository.

Returns:
    The matching products, up to a fixed limit.

schema.title: Response Search Products Api Products Get

post.description:
Creates a product by hand. Its source is recorded as `manual`.

Args:
    payload: The product fields.
    repo: The product repository.

Returns:
    The created product.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 when a product with that EAN already exists.

get.description:
Reads one product from the catalogue.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    repo: The product repository.

Returns:
    The product.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not in the catalogue.

patch.description:
Edits a product. Only the fields that are sent change.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    payload: The fields to change.
    repo: The product repository.

Returns:
    The updated product.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not in the catalogue.

get.description:
Resolves a barcode to a product: the catalogue first, then the external sources.

A 404 is a normal answer here: it tells the client to ask the user for the data.

Args:
    ean: The barcode to resolve.
    resolver: The EAN resolver.

Returns:
    The product, or a 404 response with the EAN when nobody knows it.

Lists the products the weekly review asks about, in asking order.

Args:
    service: The review service.

Returns:
    At most ten candidates; empty when there is not enough history yet.

schema.title: Response List Review Api Review Get

post.description:
Records that a product's stock was checked and is real. No movement is written.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    service: The review service.

Returns:
    An empty 204 response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not tracked.

Applies a scanned code: one unit in (`purchase`) or one unit out (`consume`).

Every outcome is a normal 200 answer, including an unknown code and a consume that
changed nothing: the client queues or reports it, it does not handle an exception.

Args:
    payload: The code, the mode and, for a new product, where it goes.
    service: The scan service.
    source: Where the scan comes from, from the `X-HomeStock-Source` header.

Returns:
    What happened, and the movement id so the client can undo it.

get.description:
Lists what the user has put on the list, with the stock of each product.

Being out of stock never puts a product here: the list holds only what was added.

Args:
    service: The shopping list service.

Returns:
    One line per product, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Get Shopping List Api Shopping List Get

post.description:
Puts a catalogue product on the list. If it is already there, sums the quantity.

Args:
    payload: The product and how much to buy.
    response: Used to answer 201 for a new line and 200 for a summed one.
    service: The shopping list service.

Returns:
    The line.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not in the catalogue.

Puts every picked-up line into the stock and takes it off the list.

All or nothing. A product that was not in the pantry is created there.

Args:
    service: The shopping list service.

Returns:
    How many lines were registered and how many of those were new in the pantry.

delete.description:
Takes a product off the list.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    service: The shopping list service.

Returns:
    An empty 204 response.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not on the list.

patch.description:
Changes the quantity to buy or the picked-up mark of a line.

Args:
    ean: The product's barcode.
    payload: The fields to change.
    service: The shopping list service.

Returns:
    The updated line.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 when the product is not on the list.
